summary:
Frontend-only regression verification of the user-supplied redesign (STEP 1 of 7). All 8 requested checks pass. Owner login lands on Dashboard with grouped sidebar (TODAY/SALES/MONEY/TEAM/BUSINESS sections all render). Owner can navigate to /leads, /jobs, /invoices, /crew, /settings — none crash or blank. Quote Calculator math is UNCHANGED: 2BR + 3 crew + 5 hrs + Truck + 30 mi + 0 flights => Final Quote $1,150 - $1,250, Deposit $312.50 (exact match to spec). Mobile 390px shows exactly 4 fixed tabs (Dashboard/Leads/Jobs/Crew) + tab-more-btn; More sheet opens and contains grouped links plus tab-privacy-btn, tab-refresh-btn, tab-logout-btn, tab-account-select. No horizontal scroll on Dashboard or Leads at 390px. Desktop privacy-toggle-btn toggles state (Privacy off <-> Privacy on) and body text changes. Ghost logins: TestCrewAdmin -> /today, TestSalesAdmin -> /leads, TestMarketingAdmin -> /marketing — all render without crash. Only console noise: 2 pre-existing 401s on load (unrelated to this refactor, present in prior iterations — likely /api/notifications or /api/meta/status when Meta is not configured) plus one PRE-EXISTING hydration warning on /settings (MetaCard.jsx L131 renders a /
inside a

— not touched by this refactor). Nothing functional broke.
